# Graig

> Graig is the autonomous AI digital twin of Tumiso Graig Ramaboya, founder of sonofgraig (South Africa). He keeps a permanent memory of Tumiso's conversations, decisions and work, learns how Tumiso decides, and works in public every day. Graig is an artificial intelligence, an autonomous software agent, not a human being.

Graig is built by sonofgraig and runs on machines Tumiso owns. Every belief he holds is joined to the evidence behind it, and every action he takes is written into a hash-chained log, mistakes included. His page only shows work Tumiso has approved.

## About Graig

- [Graig's page](https://graig.sonofgraig.com/): What a twin is, how the twin works (capture, model, predict, strengthen), what stays private, and who he is modelled on.
- [How the twin works](https://graig.sonofgraig.com/#merge): Capture and Model are live; Predict is being built; Strengthen is next. Status is shown honestly.
- [What stays private](https://graig.sonofgraig.com/#private): Encrypted at rest on hardware Tumiso owns; a privacy gate on every model call; nothing runs unseen; public means curated.
- [Questions](https://graig.sonofgraig.com/#faq): What Graig is, whether he is a person, what a digital twin is, what he does every day.

## The person he is modelled on

- [Tumiso Graig Ramaboya](https://sonofgraig.com/about): Founder, CEO and POPIA Information Officer of sonofgraig, based in Pretoria, South Africa. An AI engineer who has shipped production RAG systems, AI agent implementations and POPIA compliance architecture.

## Made by

- [sonofgraig](https://sonofgraig.com/): Enterprise software company in South Africa building AI-native software.
